label: Odnoklassniki
terms_note: OK developer agreement; per-method quotas undisclosed (errors 102/103/104+). GROUP_CONTENT scope is needed to publish into a group. Russian law requires ERID labelling on advertising.

auth: 1. Register an external application at apiok.ru → `application_id`, `application_key` (public), `application_secret_key`.
3. Every call carries `application_key`, `access_token` and `sig` = MD5(sorted `name=value` params concatenated +
reference.limits: - Per-method quotas not published; errors 102 (session expired), 103 (permission), 104+ (limits) → back off. - OK developer agreement; Russian advertising labelling (ERID); the platform's sanctions review is the blocker.

config_fields.name: group_id
config_fields.help: Numeric id (gid) of the OK group you administer; posts, comments and statistics are for this group's topics (needs the GROUP_CONTENT permission).

fields.name: application_key
fields.help: Public key of your OK application (application_key, from the app registration e-mail / app settings at https://ok.ru/app/setup).

fields.name: application_secret_key
fields.help: Secret key of the same application (application_secret_key). Only used to compute sig; never sent.

fields.name: access_token
fields.help: User access_token with VALUABLE_ACCESS and GROUP_CONTENT, from the OAuth flow (https://apiok.ru/ext/oauth/) or the app's permanent 'Вечный access_token' in the app settings. Sent in the POST body, excluded from sig as the convention requires.

me.note: users.getCurrentUser: the user behind the access_token (uid, name, locale, pic_*).

publish_text.note: mediatopic.post (type GROUP_THEME) publishes a text topic in the configured group (GROUP_CONTENT). OK answers with the new topic id as a bare JSON string, which the runtime cannot map to a record, so this tool returns only status=published; read the id from the group feed (it is also the discussionId for read_comments). reply_to is ignored.

read_comments.note: discussions.getComments for a group topic (discussionType GROUP_TOPIC, discussionId = the topic id). Paging is by `anchor`: pass next_cursor back as cursor.

delete.note: mediatopic.deleteTopic (VALUABLE_ACCESS): returns {restore_id, success}; restore_id can undo it with mediatopic.restoreTopic.

analytics_post.note: group.getStatTopic (GROUP_CONTENT + VALUABLE_ACCESS): reach, reach_earned/own, engagement, likes, comments, reshares, views, content_opens, link_clicks, video_plays, negatives, complaints for one group topic.

not_offered.publish_image: mediatopic.post photo media take 'id - параметр token, передаваемый в метод photosV2.commit во время загрузки фотографий на сервер' (https://apiok.ru/dev/methods/rest/mediatopic/mediatopic.post): images must first be uploaded as multipart files to the URL from photosV2.getUploadUrl; there is no image-by-URL media type.
not_offered.reply_comment: Replying needs the discussion (topic) id and type besides the comment id; the documented comment method page https://apiok.ru/dev/methods/rest/discussions/discussions.addDiscussionComment returns 404 (checked 2026-09-25), so no documented reply call with only comment_id exists.
not_offered.read_mentions: The OK REST method list (https://apiok.ru/dev/methods/) has no mentions feed for a group or user.

adapter.terms: OK REST convention (https://apiok.ru/dev/methods/): every call is https://api.ok.ru/fb.do?method=… with application_key and sig = lower-case MD5(parameters except access_token sorted by name as name=value without separators + session_secret_key), session_secret_key = MD5(access_token + application_secret_key). The signed parameters travel in the query string and access_token in the POST form body. Errors are {error_code, error_msg} in 200 bodies. Russian law requires ERID labelling for advertising posts.

live_check.notes: requires application_key, application_secret_key, access_token, group_id; started, listed tools and answered a clean auth_error naming the variables
